hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Prediction market hook for YES/NO share pools implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees. Requires a backend-signed sigma value per swap; fees are computed as e^(λ·Δx/L·σ), captured from the USDC collateral side via BeforeSwapDelta, and redirected to share holders through a YieldDistributor rather than to LPs.
